speed.note: （若腿與尾未伸出，兩者皆為 0 呎）

entries: 這件物品乍看是一只重 500 磅的大型密封鐵桶。桶上有個隱藏的卡榫，通過 {@dc 20} 智力（{@skill Investigation||調查}）檢定即可找到。鬆開卡榫會打開桶子一端的艙門，讓兩個中型或更小的生物爬進去。另一端排著十根拉桿，每根都在中立位置，可以上推或下拉。使用特定的拉桿時，這具裝置會變形成巨大龍蝦的模樣。
作為載具使用時，裝置需要一名駕駛員。裝置的艙門關閉時，艙室氣密且防水。艙室內的空氣足夠呼吸 10 小時，除以艙內會呼吸的生物數量。
這具裝置能浮在水面上，也能潛入水下最深 900 呎。超過這個深度，載具每分鐘會因水壓受到 {@damage 2d6} 點鈍擊傷害。
艙內的生物可以用一個動作將裝置的至多兩根拉桿上推或下拉。每次使用後，拉桿會回到中立位置。各拉桿由左至右的功能如「夸力許裝置拉桿」表所示。

rows: 腿與尾伸出，讓裝置能行走與游泳。

裝置在液體中上升至多 20 呎。

entries.name: Tilt and Roll
entries: 採取舵輪的「駕駛」動作時，船員可以花費等同船隻飛行速度一半的移動，讓船隻沿軸線翻轉，使它上下顛倒或翻回正面。船隻以此方式移動時，船上所有未固定的生物與物件都會墜落。通過 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免的生物可以抓住觸及範圍內的固定物以免墜落。

action.name: Drive (Requires Mark of Storm)
entries: 船隻朝任意方向移動至多其飛行速度。

action.name: Shift Engine (Requires Mark of Storm)
entries: 船隻的元素核心被抑制或重新啟動。
action.name_zh: 切換引擎（需要暴風印記）

vehicle.name: Tasha's Creeping Keelboat
entries: 這具魔法載具有四條腿，能推著它橫越陸地與水面。你乘坐它時，它會依你說出的指示移動，且由你選擇的生物在船上時護甲等級獲得 +1 加值。
這艘船可以不受阻礙地運送至多 1,000 磅。它最多可以負載兩倍的重量，但若負載超過正常容量，它的移動速度減半。

trait.name: Crushing Wheels
entries: 折磨者號可以穿過任何中型或更小生物的空間。這麼做時，該生物必須通過一次 {@dc 13} 敏捷豁免，否則受到 11（{@damage 2d10}）鈍擊傷害並陷入{@condition prone||伏地}狀態。若該生物原本就處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態，則額外受到 11（{@damage 2d10}）鈍擊傷害。這項特性每回合對同一個生物只能使用一次。

trait.name: Prone Deficiency
entries: 若折磨者號翻覆而陷入{@condition prone||伏地}狀態，它無法自行翻正，並陷入{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態，直到被翻回正面為止。

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: 折磨者號的武器攻擊視為魔法攻擊。

trait.name: Raking Scythes
entries: 當折磨者號在一回合內首次移動到一個未處於{@condition prone||伏地}狀態的生物或另一具載具 5 呎內時，它可以用突出的刀刃耙削該生物或載具，造成 13（{@damage 2d10 + 2}）劈砍傷害。生物通過一次 {@dc 13} 敏捷豁免便能閃開，不受傷害。載具則在其駕駛通過該豁免時閃開，不受傷害。

reaction.name: Juke
entries: 若折磨者號能夠移動，駕駛可以用其反應讓折磨者號在一次敏捷豁免上具有優勢。

weapon.name: Ballistae
entries: 裝填一門弩砲需要 1 個動作，瞄準需要 1 個動作，發射需要 1 個動作。

entries: {@atk rw} 命中 {@hit 6}，射程 120/480 呎，單一目標。{@h}16（{@damage 3d10}）穿刺傷害。

weapon.name: Mangonel
entries: 裝填彈射投石機需要 2 個動作，瞄準需要 2 個動作，發射需要 1 個動作。

action.name: Mangonel Stone
entries: {@atk rw} 命中 {@hit 5}，射程 200/800 呎（無法命中它 60 呎內的目標），單一目標。{@h}27（{@damage 5d10}）鈍擊傷害。

weapon.name: Eyestalk Cannons
entries: 這件武器看起來像一顆長在眼柄上的眼睛。駐守在暴君艦某個冥想艙裡的眼魔可以對它維持{@status concentration||專注}（如同對法術{@status concentration||專注}），藉此透過這顆眼睛視物，並用一個動作進行下列攻擊。

action.name: Destructive Ray
entries: {@atk rs} 命中 {@hit 8}，射程 120/480 呎，單一目標。{@h}35（{@damage 10d6}）力場傷害。

vehicle.name: Warship

control.name: Helm
entries: 以其中一個移動部件的速度移動，可進行一次 90 度轉向。若舵輪被摧毀，戰艦無法轉向。

35 呎；逆風航行時 15 呎；順風航行時 50 呎。

entries: {@atk rw} 命中 {@hit 5}，射程 200/800 呎（無法命中它 60 呎內的目標），單一目標。{@h}27（{@damage 5d10}）鈍擊傷害。

weapon.name: Naval Ram
entries: 戰艦撞上生物或物件時，在所有與撞擊相關的豁免檢定上具有優勢。它因撞擊受到的任何傷害都由船艏撞角承受，而非船身。若是其他船隻撞上戰艦，這些增益不適用。

action: 戰艦在它的回合可以從下列選項中採取 3 個動作。船員不足 20 名時只能採取 2 個，不足 10 名時只能採取 1 個；不足 3 名時無法採取這些動作。

items.name: Fire Ballistas
items.entry: 戰艦可以發射它的{@object ballista||弩砲}（DMG 第 8 章）。

items.name: Fire Mangonels
items.entry: 戰艦可以發射它的{@object mangonel||彈射投石機}（DMG 第 8 章）。

items.name: Move
items.entry: 戰艦可以用舵輪以船槳或船帆移動。作為這次移動的一部分，它可以使用船艏撞角。

action.name: Bolt
entries: {@atk rw} 命中 {@hit 6}，射程 120/480 呎，單一目標。{@h}16（{@damage 3d10}）穿刺傷害。

vehicleUpgrade.name: Acidic Bile Sprayer

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 武器崗位（1 名乘員、半掩護，充能 5–6）：向 30 呎錐形範圍噴灑酸液，敏捷豁免 DC 12，失敗受到 40（9d8）酸蝕傷害，成功減半；因此降至 0 生命值的生物會被溶解。
This hose weapon is attached to demonic organs that produce an acidic bile that dissolves flesh on contact.

entries.name: Acidic Bile Sprayer (Requires 1 Crew and Grants Half Cover, {@recharge 5|m})
entries: Acidic bile sprays from a nozzle in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 40 ({@damage 9d8}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage is dissolved, leaving behind any objects it was carrying or wearing.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Arcane Artillery

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船載武器的攻擊檢定與傷害擲骰獲得 +2 加值，攻擊視為魔法攻擊。

Using methods similar to those used to produce magic weapons, a skilled spellcaster imbues a ship's weapon with destructive energy. This weapon gains a +2 bonus to its attack and damage rolls, and its attacks count as magical.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Bones of Endless Toil

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 類人生物在船上死亡時進行感知豁免（DC 12），失敗便立即化為聽命於船長的殭屍並充當船員；同時活化的數量上限等同船隻的生物容量。

The bones of ancient, mysterious creatures festoon the ship. Potent runes crawl across these remains, emitting a sickly green radiance. When a humanoid dies aboard the ship, that creature must make a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, it dies as normal. If it fails, it immediately rises as a {@creature zombie} obedient to the ship's captain. The zombie gains a working knowledge of the ship, allowing it to serve as a member of the crew. A number of creatures equal to the ship's creature capacity can be animated in this manner at any given time.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Canian Armor

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 煉獄戰爭機器的 AC 變為 22 + 敏捷調整值，並額外免疫寒冰傷害與極端嚴寒；但載具靜止時，對它的攻擊檢定具有優勢。

The infernal iron used to make the vehicle was mined on Cania, the coldest layer of the Nine Hells. An infernal war machine with Canian armor has an Armor Class of 22 + its Dexterity modifier. While the vehicle is not moving, attack rolls made against it have advantage. The infernal war machine also has immunity to cold damage in addition to its other damage immunities, and it's immune to the effects of extreme cold.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Churning Hull

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船隻周圍 210 呎內的水域，對這艘船以外的一切都是困難地形。
A tempest rages within these rune-etched, iron chains. Raiders and pirates who operate under the blessings of a storm god sometimes make use of this upgrade.

By draping the chains over a ship's hull, the storm's fury thrashes into the water around it. The water within 210 feet of the ship is {@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形} for everything other than this ship.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Clockwork Oars

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船槳只需一名船員即可操作。
Using a combination of magic and clockwork, the oars on this ship require only one crew member to use them, pushing the button or lever that activates them.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Concussive Rounds

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 這件武器命中載具的船身時，該載具的速度減少 2d10 呎，直到攻擊者的下個回合開始。

Enhanced by abjuration magic, this weapon's attacks burst with raucous noise capable of momentarily distracting and disorienting enemy crews. If this weapon hits a vehicle's hull, that vehicle's speed decreases by {@dice 2d10} feet until the start of the attacker's next turn.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Death Vessel

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船隻可以用一個動作放出恐懼脈衝：船上與 210 呎內的敵對生物進行感知豁免（DC 14），失敗則對這艘船恐懼 1 分鐘，成功則 24 小時內免疫。使用後需等 1d4 小時才能再次使用。

Crafted with materials harvested from the Shadowfell, this upgrade grants a ship an aura of dread. As an action, the ship can create a pulse of horrific energy. Every creature that is an enemy of the ship who is on board or within 210 feet of it must make {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is {@condition frightened} of the ship for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this ability for 24 hours. Once this ability is used, it can't be used again until {@dice 1d4} hours have passed.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Defiant Sails

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船帆張開時，從船外對這艘船與船上人員進行的遠程武器攻擊具有劣勢。

These sails glitter with a fine coat of mithral treated with abjuration magic. While the sails are unfurled, ranged weapon attacks made against the ship and anyone aboard it are made with disadvantage, as a result of the sails' protective magic. This drawback doesn't apply if the attacker is aboard the ship.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Dragon Sails

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船帆的 AC 獲得 +3 加值，並依製作所用龍鱗的種類獲得一種傷害抗性（見原文表格）。

Dragon scales woven into these sails make them more resistant to damage. The sails gain a +3 bonus to AC, and they have resistance to a damage type based on the type of scales used to craft them, as shown on the Dragon Sails table.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Ever-Full Sails

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 無論風向如何，船隻都能以 60 呎的速度航行。

These billowing sails are woven from cloud-stuff drawn from the Elemental Plane of Air. Wind whips and whistles around them, allowing a ship to move with a speed of 60 feet regardless of direction relative to the wind.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Explosive Rounds

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 這件武器命中時額外造成 2d6 火焰傷害。
Drawing on powerful evocation magic, this weapon's attacks are imbued with unstable energy that explodes in a fiery blast. When this weapon hits, it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} fire damage.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Flamethrower

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 武器崗位（1 名乘員、半掩護）：噴出 60 呎長、5 呎寬的火線，敏捷豁免 DC 15，失敗受到 18（4d8）火焰傷害，成功減半，並點燃範圍內未被穿戴或攜帶的易燃物件。
Although useless against demons, this weapon is great against flammable creatures and objects.

entries.name: Flamethrower (Requires 1 Crew and Grants Half Cover)
entries: Fire shoots out of the weapon's nozzle in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being carried or worn.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Frost-Locked Hull

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船身與其他部件免疫寒冰傷害，但具有火焰傷害易傷；船隻能以正常速度在任何厚度的冰面上航行。

This upgrade replaces a ship's hull with supernatural ice drawn from the elemental planes. The hull and the other components of the ship are immune to cold damage but vulnerable to fire damage. The ship can also move at its normal speed over ice of any thickness, floating on the ice at the same depth as it would in water.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Gilded Death Armor

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 煉獄戰爭機器獲得鈍擊、穿刺與劈砍傷害抗性；鍍金無法拆下，載具生命值降至 0 時化為塵土。

Gold stolen or bartered from the archdevil Mammon plates the vehicle's exterior. This gold can't be removed without destroying the vehicle and turns to dust when the infernal war machine drops to 0 hit points. Gilded death armor grants the infernal war machine resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Grasping Rounds

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 這件武器命中船隻時，該載具須通過力量豁免（DC 14），否則無法遠離攻擊者；攻擊方可用一個動作解除，目標可用一個動作並通過 DC 14 力量檢定掙脫。

This weapon creates spectral chains that trail after its shots, restraining enemy vessels in their grasp. When this weapon hits a ship, that vehicle must succeed on a {@dc 14} Strength saving throw or it can't move away from the attacker. As an action, the attacking ship can end this effect, and the target can end it by taking an action and succeeding on a {@dc 14} Strength check.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Guardian Figurehead

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船隻可以用一個動作讓船艏像活化為鐵魔像，行動 1 分鐘後回到原位；每 24 小時一次。

This figurehead depicts an armored knight. As an action, the ship can activate this item, causing it to animate as an {@creature iron golem}. The golem acts on the ship's turn when the captain uses one of the ship's actions. The golem remains animated for 1 minute. At the end of that time, it teleports back to its position as a figurehead. Once a ship uses this action, it can't use it again for 24 hours.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Infernal Screamer

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 武器崗位（1 名乘員、半掩護）：操作員以 120 呎內一個看得見的生物為目標，感知豁免 DC 15，失敗受到 26（4d12）精神傷害，成功減半。
A writhing humanoid torso made of melting wax juts out from this station, with a barbed hand crank between its shoulder blades. The figure telepathically shrieks in agony when the crank is turned.

entries.name: Infernal Screamer (Requires 1 Crew and Grants Half Cover)
entries: The screamer's operator targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of the screamer. The target must make a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw, taking 26 ({@damage 4d12}) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Living Vessel

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船隻的所有體質檢定與豁免獲得 +2 加值；只要至少還有 1 點生命值，每分鐘恢復 10 點生命值。

This vessel's hull was crafted in the Feywild under the direction of master eladrin shipwrights. It is a living plant, drawing sustenance from water and sunlight. Vines covered in thick leaves hang over its side, and the wood runs with fresh sap when damaged. The ship gains a +2 bonus to all Constitution checks or saving throws. As long as the ship has at least 1 hit point, it regains 10 hit points every minute.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Necrotic Smoke Screen

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 駕駛可以用一個附贈動作，在載具正前方或正後方噴出邊長 30 呎的立方體濃煙，持續 1 分鐘；範圍內重度遮蔽，在一回合內首次進入或在其中開始回合的生物受到 21（6d6）死靈傷害。強風可吹散；使用後需 24 小時充能。

The vehicle's driver can activate this magical device as a bonus action, causing the vehicle to expel a 30-foot cube of opaque smoke directly in front of it or behind it. The cloud is stationary and lasts for 1 minute. The area within it is heavily obscured. Any creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage. A strong wind disperses the cloud. This device needs 24 hours to recharge before it can be used again.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Red Dragon Figurehead

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船隻可以用一個動作從船艏像噴出 60 呎錐形火焰，敏捷豁免 DC 12，失敗受到 21（6d6）火焰傷害，成功減半；每分鐘一次。

This figurehead depicts a red dragon rearing to strike, its mouth open. As an action, the ship can activate this item to create a 60-foot cone of flame that originates from the figurehead. Each creature and object in the cone must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Once a ship uses this action, it can't use it again for 1 minute.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Reinforced Hull

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船身的生命值上限加倍。
A master shipwright can use superior materials and clever design to make a ship's hull more resilient. Such reinforcement doubles the hull's hit point maximum.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Screaming Sails

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船長位於船帆 5 呎內時，可以用一個動作讓船帆發出嚎叫：船上與 300 呎內的敵對生物進行感知豁免（DC 14），失敗受到 4d6 精神傷害並恐懼 1 分鐘。使用後需等 2d6 小時。

Woven from the energy of captured wraiths and bound with the spirit of a banshee, these sails groan mournfully when they catch the wind. As an action, while within 5 feet of the sails, the ship's captain can cause the sails to unleash a howl. Every creature hostile to the ship who is on board or within 300 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom saving throw, or the creature takes {@damage 4d6} psychic damage and is then {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. Once this ability has been used, it can't be used again until {@dice 2d6} hours have passed.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Scything Oars

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船隻以這組船槳移動時，移動途中任何時刻位於它 10 呎內水中的生物或物件進行敏捷豁免（DC 10），失敗受到 2d6 劈砍傷害，成功減半。

Sharpened, magically reinforced oars make a vessel dangerous to approach. When the ship takes an action that moves it with these oars, any creature or object in the water within 10 feet of it at any point of the move must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 2d6} slashing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Smuggler's Banner

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 旗幟在觀看者眼中會顯示為對其友善的勢力標誌。船隻可以用一個動作，連同船上的友方生物傳送至多 3 哩到船長選擇的已知地點（敵對生物留在原處落水）；使用後需等 2d6 天。

This flag is meant to be flown from a ship's mast. Its powerful magic causes it to appear as a flag or banner displaying the symbol of a group, captain, or realm friendly to the viewer. Multiple viewers might see different flags or crests.

The banner's true power is its ability to aid a ship in making rapid escapes. As an action, the ship and all friendly creatures aboard it teleport up to 3 miles to a known destination of the captain's choice. Hostile creatures aboard the ship don't move with the ship and fall into the water it once occupied. Once this item is used to teleport, it can't teleport in this way again for {@dice 2d6} days.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Soul Spike Armor

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 非魔鬼的生物在載具 30 呎內死亡時，靈魂會被釘在尖刺上，期間無法以任何方式復活。載具被摧毀、對該尖刺施放移除詛咒或類似魔法，或摧毀尖刺（小型物件，AC 19、生命值 15，除光耀外抗所有傷害）可釋放靈魂。
The vehicle is covered with spikes inscribed with blasphemous symbols. Luminous, ghostly figures impaled on these spikes wail and reach out in agony.

If a creature that isn't a devil dies within 30 feet of the infernal war machine, its soul (if it has one) is torn from its body and joins the wailing throng impaled on the spikes. As long as its soul remains trapped, a creature can't be raised from the dead by any means. A trapped soul is freed if the vehicle is destroyed, if the spike anchoring it is the target of a {@spell remove curse} spell or similar magic, or if the spike is destroyed. Each spike is a Small object with AC 19, 15 hit points, and resistance to all damage except radiant damage.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Storm Giant Figurehead

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 船隻可以用一個動作從船艏像放出 60 呎錐形衝擊，體質豁免 DC 12，失敗受到 14（4d6）雷鳴傷害並被推離 10 呎，成功傷害減半；每分鐘一次。

This figurehead depicts a storm giant clutching a thunderbolt. As an action, the ship can activate this item to create a 60-foot cone that originates from the figurehead. Each creature in the cone must make {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails its saving throw is also pushed 10 feet away from the figurehead. Once a ship uses this action, it can't use it again for 1 minute.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Styx Sprayer

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 武器崗位（1 名乘員、半掩護，可用 3 次）：遠程法術攻擊 +5、射程 30 呎，命中的生物成為弱智術的目標（豁免 DC 20）；若 30 天內未解除，效果變為永久並失去所有記憶。水箱須到冥河補充。

This flexible hose is connected to a tank that holds 30 gallons of water from the {@adventure River Styx|BGDIA|3|River Styx}. Each use of the weapon depletes 10 gallons of the water. Refilling the tank requires access to the Styx.

entries.name: Styx Sprayer (Requires 1 Crew and Grants Half Cover; 3 Uses)
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 5} to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. {@h}The creature is struck by water from the River Styx and targeted by a {@spell feeblemind} spell (save {@dc 20}). An already feebleminded creature is immune to this effect, as is a creature adapted to the River Styx. If the target fails its saving throw and the spell's effect on it is not ended within 30 days, the effect becomes permanent, whereupon the creature loses all its memories and becomes a near-mindless shell of its former self. At that point, nothing short of divine intervention can undo the effect.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Taskmaster's Drums

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 生物可以用一個動作啟動銅鼓；接下來 1 分鐘內，船隻只要至少有一個動作，就多獲得一個動作。使用後需等 2d10 小時。

This 4-foot-tall bronze drum comes with a pair of iron mallets. A creature can activate the drums as an action, causing the hammers to float above the drum and strike it to produce a thundering rhythm. For the next minute, the ship gains one additional action, as long as it has at least one action. Once this item is used, it can't be activated again for {@dice 2d10} hours.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Teleporter

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 駕駛可以用一個附贈動作，讓載具連同與它接觸的所有生物和物件傳送到 300 呎內一處看得見的未被佔據空間；使用後需 24 小時充能。

The vehicle's driver can activate this magical device as a bonus action, causing the vehicle to teleport to an unoccupied space that the driver can see up to 300 feet away from the vehicle's current position. All creatures and objects in contact with the vehicle are teleported along with it. This device needs 24 hours to recharge before it can be used again.

vehicleUpgrade.name: Vigilant Watch

entries.name: 中文簡介
entries: 隱形的生物在船上或船隻 120 呎內時會現形。

A row of crystal orbs, each filled with viscous liquid and a beholder's eyeball, is mounted along this ship's hull. {@condition Invisible} creatures are visible while on the ship or within 120 feet of it.
